_doc: Cases that the web client (src/client) and the Godot client (vone/scripts/game_logic.gd) must answer identically. test/client-parity.test.js runs them through JavaScript, vone/tests/run_tests.gd through GDScript. Kind codes follow KIND in src/sim/state.js. Tap cases use the real data files and the map of seed 1234567; ids 1 and 2 are the Cores, the entity lists below are small on purpose. M4 adds mixFor, queueLines, groupActions and the path and merge modes of resolveTap.
